basic_info.description: Must-see property for those who seek flexibility, space, and opportunity. OFFERED WITH UNIT 495 FOR $1,249,000. See listing #425011322. Built in 1904, 489-495 Utah is a three-unit building with a legal cottage (accessory dwelling unit- ADU), situated between Mariposa and 17th. Stripped down to the studs in 2018, Unit 489 features 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, wide-plank hardwood floors extend throughout the home, and the sunny living room benefits from windows on two sides. The third bedroom, located at the back of the property has been converted into a dining room, creating a more open appealing layout. The door between the dining area and kitchen has been removed to enhance flow. The office or bonus room has added closets and is currently used as a bedroom. The kitchen includes Carrara marble countertops, generous cabinet space, sleek built-in shelving, and Thermador appliances. The primary bedroom has a large closet, windows on two sides, and direct access to a private deck and yard (common area). This property is ideally purchased with the studio apartment-ADU (unit 495) with similar design and finishes that is also for sale. Perfect for WFH, in-laws, passive income, gear, yoga, man/woman cave, startup, you name it. Come take a look.
